content:
With macOS 27 Golden Gate expected to officially launch later this year, Apple continues its beta testing efforts and has now released the fifth beta to developers. Here's a preview of what's included.

Apple releases macOS 27 beta 5

Three weeks ago, Apple rolled out macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 4, followed by the corresponding public beta a few days later.

Now, the company is pushing out macOS Golden Gate beta 5, continuing to address bug fixes and performance issues ahead of this year's official release.

macOS 27 Golden Gate introduces an all-new Siri app, along with a redesigned Siri AI. The system also features a new AI-powered version of the Shortcuts app that accepts natural language commands for building shortcuts, and offers a prompt-based Safari extension builder.

In addition, macOS 27 Golden Gate brings new Golden Gate-style wallpapers and screensavers, while reverting window and app corner radius to a fixed size. This change reverses a shift introduced in macOS 26, which adjusted corner radius based on the contents of each window or app's menu bar.

macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 5 carries build number 26A5406e. We're digging into this new beta now and will share our findings later.

How to install the macOS 27 Golden Gate beta

Here's how to install the macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 5:

  • Back up your Mac
  • Open System Settings
  • Go to General → Software Update
  • Click the "i" icon next to "Beta Updates"
  • Select "macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta" from the dropdown in the upper right
  • Click "Done"

Have you discovered anything new in this macOS 27 Golden Gate beta? Let us know in the comments.
